header_sentences: See Angel of Jehovah; and see God.

contexts.text: In the day in which Jehovah God made the earth and the heavens ()... That it here treats of the formation of the celestial man... is still further evident from the fact that now for the first time it is said Jehovah God. In what precedes, where it treats of the spiritual man, it is merely said God. AC 300.
Jehovah God or the Lord.
The reason Jehovah God speaks in the singular, and afterwards in the plural () is that by Jehovah God is meant the Lord, and at the same time the angelic Heaven. AC 300, Explained.
He is called Jehovah because He alone Is, or lives, thus from essence; and God... from power. Illustrated.
Then began they to call on the name of Jehovah () = the worship of that Church from charity. (Explained.)
To call on the name of Jehovah, is a general formula of all the worship of the Lord. Illustrated.
The invocation of the name of Jehovah did not now first begin... Therefore by to call on the name of Jehovah nothing else is signified than the worship of a new Church...

When there is not a Church, it is said God; but when there is a Church, it is said Jehovah... Jehovah is most holy, and is not said except of the Church... No one was allowed to mention Jehovah, unless he had the Knowledge of true faith; but anyone might mention God.
With Jehovah there is nothing but Esse.
Jehovah said to Noah () = that it was so done; as is evident from the fact that with Jehovah there is nothing but Esse...

It is said, Jehovah, because it is now treating of charity. In the preceding chapter... it is not said Jehovah, but God, because it there treats of the preparation of Noah... as to his intellectual things, which are of faith; but here, of his preparation as to voluntary things, which are of love. When intellectual things are being treated of, it is said God; when voluntary things... Jehovah. For intellectual things... do not constitute the Church, but voluntary things... Jehovah is in love and charity, but not in faith, unless it is the faith of love or of charity... AC 840:end.
Charity is the very esse and life of man in the other life; Esse and Life itself is Jehovah; and therefore before a man is and lives, it is not said that Jehovah is with him, but that God is.

When it is predicated of Jehovah that He says, nothing else is meant than that so it is, or is not, or that so it is done; for of Jehovah nothing else can be said than that He is. The things which are predicated of Jehovah in the Word -passim-, are for those who can apprehend nothing except from such things as are with man... AC 1410.

(As the nations of Canaan named Baal, Ashtaroth, etc., so) the Jews named Jehovah supposing that the mere naming of Jehovah would make them holy and chosen, when yet this has rather condemned them beyond others...
Blessed be Jehovah the God of Shem () = all good for those who worship the Lord from internal things.

It is here said, Blessed be Jehovah God, because it is treating of Shem, or the Internal Church, which Church is called internal from charity. The Lord is present in charity, and He is therefore here called Jehovah God.
As Nimrod, mighty in hunting before Jehovah ()... The reason it is said before Jehovah, is that those who were in such worship, called faith separated Jehovah, or a man Jehovah.
Jehovah or the Lord is everywhere present, and knows all things...
Under Hebrew, see this reference.

The Most Ancient Church unanimously acknowledged the Lord, and named Him Jehovah... The Ancient Church... also acknowledged the Lord, and called Him Jehovah; especially those who had internal worship and were called sons of Shem. The rest, who were in external worship, also acknowledged Jehovah, and worshipped Him. But when internal worship became external, and still more when it became idolatrous, and when each nation began to have its own god... the Hebrew nation retained the name Jehovah, and called their god Jehovah; and in this were distinguished from all the other nations. The descendants of Jacob in Egypt... lost this also, - that they called their god Jehovah; nay, Moses himself did so; and therefore they were instructed first of all that Jehovah was the God of the Hebrews, and the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Illustrated.
Balaam... called his God Jehovah. Illustrated, Explained. AC 1366:end.
Its being said of Noah that he offered burnt-offerings to Jehovah, is not a true historical...
A great part (of the Second Ancient Church) did not acknowledge Jehovah as God, but worshipped other gods. Illustrated.
Terah and Abram... worshipped other gods, and were ignorant of Jehovah.
That the Lord's Human Essence... might become Jehovah. AC 1475:end. AC 1502:3. AC 1568:end.
He was conceived of Jehovah.
The Lord's Hereditary from Jehovah was Divine.
See H (the letter) here. AC 2010, etc.
Because He was born from Jehovah.

Because in celestial things is the Divine Itself, that is, Jehovah Himself. And as the Lord then conjoined the Human Essence with the Divine one... it could not be otherwise than that Jehovah should appear to Him.
As soon as Jehovah appeared to the Lord in His celestial things...
The Lord, who from His infancy progressed to Jehovah...
Jehovah was seen by Abram () = that Jehovah appeared to the Lord when He was still a child.
He built there an altar to Jehovah () = the first worship of His Father from the Celestial of love.
He built an altar to Jehovah () = the worship of His Father from that external state.
And he called on the name of Jehovah () = the worship of His Father from that internal state. AC 1561.
The interiors with Him were Divine from Jehovah His Father.
The Lord was born from Jehovah the Father, and thus was Divine or Jehovah as to internals.
The garden of Jehovah () is said, when the Rational is celestial, that is, is from a celestial origin...
Jehovah said to Abram () = that Jehovah thus spake to the Lord.
The Lord as to the internal man was Divine, because He was born from Jehovah.
(Then) the internal man, or Jehovah, acted as one with the external...
His Human Essence... when united to the Divine one, also was Jehovah. AC 1729:2.
For Jehovah is present in celestial love.

The internal man, together with this interior man, was Jehovah the Father Himself. But... His interior man as to truths was adjoined to the external man, and thus was human; but this also... was made Divine, that is, Jehovah. AC 1725:2.
The internal man, which was Jehovah. Signified.
Thus that the Lord is the same as Jehovah the Father. Illustrated.
With the Lord all is Jehovah, not only His internal and interior man, but also His external man, and the very body...
The interior or rational man, which was to be united to the internal man, or Jehovah...
The conjunction of the internal man, or Jehovah, with the interior and exterior man. Signified, Explained.
The Lord as to the internal man was Jehovah Himself...
In the Ancient Church, Jehovah was called God Most High.
Jehovah, or the Lord's Internal, was the very Celestial of love; that is, love itself; with which no other attributes agree than those which are of pure love...

This love itself is Jehovah; of no other thing can I am or Is be predicated, than of love. From this love... is the Esse of all life... and as Jehovah alone is the Esse of life, each and all things have thence their esse and their life; nor can anything be and live from itself except Jehovah alone, that is, the Lord alone...
That the Lord is Jehovah... Illustrated.
The Jewish Church acknowledged... no other as Jehovah, because they worshipped the one God Jehovah.
Love itself, which is Jehovah.
Until His Human Essence was in like manner made love, or the Esse of life, that is, Jehovah.
Jehovah = ... the Lord.

In a state of temptations the Lord spoke with Jehovah as with another; but in proportion as His Human Essence was united to His Divine one, He spoke with Jehovah as with Himself... (For) in proportion anything of (the Hereditary from the mother) remained, He was as it were absent from Jehovah; but in proportion as this was extirpated. He was present with, and was Himself Jehovah. (Shown by comparison.)
But with the Lord there was effected a plenary conjunction, or eternal union, with Jehovah, so that His Human Essence itself is also Jehovah.
(The Lord at such times) had immediate communication with Jehovah.
There was a continual communication and internal conversation with Jehovah, which the Lord alone had. This is meant... wherever the expression occurs, Abram said to Jehovah.

I am Jehovah () = the Lord's internal man, which was Jehovah... The Internal of the Lord, that is, whatever the Lord received from the Father, was Jehovah in Him, for He had been conceived from Jehovah. Explained.

Hence it may be evident, that the Lord as to internals was Jehovah. But as the External... was to be united to Jehovah, and this by temptations... it could not appear otherwise to Him when in those states than that when He spoke with Jehovah, He spoke as it were with another, when yet He was speaking with Himself...
The perception which the Lord had... was from His Internal itself; that is, from Jehovah Himself; which is here signified by... Jehovah said unto him.
Jehovah or the Lord appears to everyone such as he is...
Jehovah made a covenant with Abram () = the conjunction of the Lord's interior man with His internal man.

For the Lord progressed more and more to conjunction and union with Jehovah His Father, until... the Human Essence itself was also Jehovah, Who was the Internal itself of the Lord. This was represented by the covenant which Jehovah made with Abram. Explained.

The internal man with the Lord was Jehovah Himself; for He had been conceived from Jehovah; and therefore He so often mentioned His Father, and is called the Only-begotten of God, and the Only Son of God.
Abram = the Lord's internal man, which is Jehovah. The reason the Lord's internal man, which is Jehovah, is called a Man, is that no one is man except Jehovah alone...
In proportion as the Lord united the Human Essence to the Divine one, He thought from the Divine good itself, that is, from Jehovah.
Jehovah judge between me and between thee () = the Lord's indignation.
The Lord's perception was immediately from Jehovah, thus from the Divine good; but His thought was from intellectual truth and its affection.

But after the Lord's Human Essence had become... Jehovah, then the Lord was above that which is called perception, because He was above the order which is in the Heavens... It is Jehovah from whom is order; hence it may be said that Jehovah is order itself...
The Rational was conceived from the internal man, which was Jehovah, as a Father, and was born from the exterior man as a mother.

He who is conceived from Jehovah has no other Internal, that is, no other soul, than Jehovah; and therefore as to His veriest life He was Jehovah Himself. Jehovah, or the Divine Essence, cannot be divided, like the soul of a man's father...
Hence it is evident that He is the same as Jehovah the Father. Illustrated.
In proportion as He united Himself with His Internal, or Jehovah, His thought became more interior, and intellectual truth was united to Divine good.
She called the name of Jehovah who spake unto her () = the state of the Lord's interior man when He was thinking these things. Explained.
That Jehovah was manifested to the Lord in His Human. Treated of. AC 1990.

This is why when Jehovah appeared to the men of the Most Ancient Church, and afterwards to those of the Ancient Church... and also to Abraham and the prophets. He was manifested to them as a man; and that He was the Lord, He Himself openly teaches. Illustrated.
(Thus) the Infinite Esse, which is Jehovah, could never be manifested to a man, except through the Human Essence...
The rest of the arcana concerning the manifestation of Jehovah in the Lord's Human, when He was in a state of humiliation... will be expounded in what follows...
The house of Terah... was among the families of the nations which had not only lost the name of Jehovah, but also served other gods, and instead of Jehovah worshipped Shaddai... Illustrated.
Jehovah = good; Shaddai, truth.

The Lord prayed to Jehovah His Father... although Jehovah was in Him; but the state in which the Lord then was, was His state of humiliation... But in His state of glorification He spoke with Jehovah as with Himself; for He was Jehovah Himself. Explained. AC 2159:3. AC 2250:end.

In proportion therefore as the Lord was in the human... from the mother, He appeared distinct from Jehovah, and adored Jehovah as one different from Himself; but in proportion as He put off this human, the Lord was not distinct from Jehovah, but was one with Him...
In the state of humiliation or adoration... He was more conjoined and united with Jehovah; for humiliation is attended with this.

The Lord is sometimes called Jehovah, sometimes Jehovah God, also the Lord Jehovah, and sometimes God; and this always from a secret cause in the internal sense. When it is treating of love or of good, and of the Celestial Church, Jehovah is mentioned; but when of faith or truth, and of the Spiritual Church, God is mentioned; and this constantly; because the very Esse of the Lord is of love; and the derivative Esse is of faith... AC 2528.
Everywhere by Jehovah in the Word of the Old Testament is meant the Lord, because all the rites of the Church represented Him...
Jehovah, who is here speaking, was in Him, because He was one with Him from His first conception and birth; for He was conceived from Jehovah, and thence His Internal was Jehovah. AC 2025:4.
Abraham... represents the Lord's internal man... The Lord's internal man was Jehovah Himself.
Thus the three Men, that is, the Divine Itself, the Divine Human, and the Holy proceeding, are the same as the Lord, and the Lord is the same as Jehovah.
The Human begins in the inmost of the Rational; that which was above it was Jehovah Himself...
(For) now Jehovah was present, and spoke with Abraham; and Jehovah was the Divine Itself of the Lord, and was not separate from Him...
For the Internal itself of the Lord was Jehovah.
That everything is possible to Jehovah. Signified.
By the coming of the three Men, or of Jehovah, to Abraham, was represented the Lord's Divine perception...
That the Divine Itself, the Divine Human, and the Holy proceeding are Jehovah. Illustrated.
From with Jehovah out of heaven () = from the laws of order as to truth, because they separate themselves from good. Explained.

From its being said, that Jehovah made to rain from with Jehovah out of heaven, it appears... as if there were two; one on earth, and one in Heaven; but the internal sense teaches... that by the first-named Jehovah is meant the Lord's Divine Human and Holy proceeding, in this chapter meant by the two men; and that by the second-named Jehovah is meant the Divine Itself which is called the Father... AC 6000:7.
(Why ears, eyes, etc., are attributed to Jehovah.) AC 3869:14.
God is said where it treats of truth; and Jehovah, where of good.
Jehovah visited Sarah () = the presence of the Divine Celestial in the Divine Spiritual. Jehovah = the Divine Celestial; that is, the Divine good, or Esse itself...
The second arcanum is, that the Lord's Divine Human was not only conceived, but was also born from Jehovah... The third is, that the Lord's Divine Human is the name of Jehovah... AC 2649:2. AC 2798.
The Divine Esse of life, or Jehovah, was in the Lord from conception, and the like Esse of life came forth in His Human by union.
No one lives from himself except Jehovah alone, that is, the Lord.
Hence He was no longer the son of Mary, but was Jehovah as to each Essence.
Where good is treated of, Jehovah is mentioned. Hence... in the things which follow, it is said Jehovah, because it treats of deliverance... For all deliverance and salvation are from good.
The very Esse of His life was Jehovah. AC 2798:2.
Jehovah is said where it treats of good from which is consolation. AC 2826.

In general, when it treats of the celestial things of love, or concerning good, it is said Jehovah; but when of the spiritual things of faith, or concerning truth, it is said God; and when of both together, it is said Jehovah God. (Continued. See Jehovah Zebaoth.)
In the Word of the Old Testament, Lord involves the like as Jehovah; namely, in that Lord is said when it treats of good... Illustrated.
But in the Word of the New Testament... Jehovah is nowhere mentioned, but instead of Jehovah, Lord is said, and this from secret causes... Illustrated, Explained.

Among other secret reasons for calling Jehovah the Lord, were [these]: that if at that time it had been said that the Lord was the Jehovah so often mentioned in the Old Testament... they would not have received it... Also, that the Lord had not become Jehovah as to the Human...

Jehovah blessed Abraham in all things () = when all things had been disposed by the Lord into Divine order... Jehovah = the Lord as to the Divine itself (References.); and then Abraham represents the Lord as to the Divine Human... AC 3119.

I adjure thee by Jehovah God of heaven and God of earth () = a most holy binding to the Divine which is in supremes, and in the things thence derived... that is, to the Divine which is above, and which is beneath... Jehovah God of heaven, being said of the Lord, = Jehovah Himself who is called the Father, from whom He was conceived, thus who was His Divine Essence... Jehovah God of earth = in this case Jehovah who is called the Son, thus His Human Essence... The Lord, however, is called Jehovah God of heaven from His Divine which is in the Heavens, and the God of earth from the Divine which is on earth... AC 3035. AC 3061.
By Jehovah, who is so often mentioned in the Word of the Old Testament, is meant the Lord alone... And the Most Ancients... understood no other by Jehovah than the Lord. AC 3160. AC 3195:8.
There are many things in the Lord, and all are Jehovah... AC 3061, References.
That the whole Trinity in the Lord is Jehovah. References.

I have heard from (the men of the Most Ancient Church) that Jehovah Himself was the Lord as to the Divine Human when He descended into Heaven and inflowed through Heaven... The Divine Itself in Heaven... was Jehovah Himself thus clothed with the Human.
But when the human race had become such that... Jehovah could no longer come to man... then Jehovah, who is the Lord as to the Divine Essence, descended, and took on the Human...
Because the veriest Esse of the Lord was Jehovah or the Divine good itself; and the veriest Esse of the Lord thence, was of Jehovah, or the Divine truth itself...
Isaac prayed to Jehovah () = the communication of the Divine which is the Son with the Divine which is the Father... This communication was in the Lord...
Jehovah appeared to him, and said () = thought from the Divine.
That Jehovah was in the Lord, and that the Lord Himself was Jehovah. References.
To dwell in the house of Jehovah = to be and to live in the good of love.
Not to dwell in the land of Jehovah = not to be in a state of the good of love.
Jehovah blessed him () = as to the good of love in them... For Jehovah is the very Esse of love or of good...

Jehovah appeared to him... () = the Lord's perception... For Jehovah was in Him; thus so long as the Human was not yet glorified, the appearing of Jehovah was Divine perception, or perception from the Divine.
That Jehovah was with thee () = that the Divine was therein.
They who were of the Ancient Church, by all these denominations meant the One God, namely the Lord, whom they called Jehovah...
I appeared to Abraham. Isaac, and Jacob in the God Shaddai, and by My name Jehovah I was not known to them (). Explained.
Jehovah standing upon it () = the Lord in the highest.
I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham thy father () = the Lord, that this good is from Him; (for) Jehovah = the Lord's Divine Esse itself...
Surely Jehovah is in this place () = the Divine in this state.
(Those of the Jews) who worshipped Jehovah, did so only as some god who was called Jehovah...
Jehovah shall be to me for a God () = that the Divine Natural also should be Jehovah. Explained.
That all the Lord's Human is the Divine Esse, or Jehovah. References.
Jehovah is said from Esse or Essence. Hence... Jehovah is said when it treats of good. AC 3921:3. AC 3969:5.
Esse is in the Lord alone, and it is called Jehovah... The Lord's Human was made the Divine Esse, that is, Jehovah. That the Lord is Jehovah as to each Essence. References.
It was enjoined on the family of Abraham that they should acknowledge Jehovah as their God; but still they acknowledged Him no otherwise than as another god... thus as to the mere name...

In order that a representative Church might come forth, and thus some communication of the Lord through Heaven with man, they had to be kept in this especially, - that they should acknowledge Jehovah, if not at heart, still with the mouth...
The principal external was, that they should confess Jehovah; for Jehovah was the Lord, who was represented in all things of that Church.
That thus He might become Jehovah, not only as to the Human Rational, but also as to the Human Natural. Signified.
a. That both the Divine Itself and the Divine Human are Jehovah. Signified.
The Jews had no other idea of Jehovah than as of a very old man with a long and snowy beard, who could do miracles above the other gods...

Jehovah was only representatively present (with the Jews)... For they believed that Jehovah led into temptations, that all evil was from Him, and that He was in anger and fury when they were being punished...
They confessed Jehovah with the mouth only, and merely in order that they might be the greatest...
Therefore they called every Angel who appeared Jehovah.
That the Lord, when seen by (the men of the Ancient Churches) was called Jehovah. Illustrated.
His proprium from conception was that which He had from Jehovah His Father, and was Jehovah Himself.
They believed that Jehovah was a greater god, because He could do greater miracles...
Jehovah was with Joseph () = that the Divine was in the Celestial of the Spiritual. AC 4974. AC 4980. AC 5041. AC 5048.
Hence, in the supreme sense, the Lord is called Esse, or Jehovah...

Therefore it pleased Jehovah to present Himself actually, such as He is, and such as He appears in Heaven; namely, as a Divine Man... This Divine, or this of Jehovah in Heaven, is the Lord from eternity...
When He had glorified Himself, He then... became the Divine good itself, or Jehovah, even as to the Human.
By Jehovah, and God (the Ancient and Most Ancient Churches) understood no other than the Lord... as to the Divine Human...
Jehovah manifested Himself with the Ancients in the Divine Human...
Jehovah = the Lord as to good.
It is called the glory of Jehovah relatively to the Inmost Heaven...
Jehovah shall be for a King over all the earth; in that day there shall be one Jehovah, and His name one () = the Lord as to the Divine Human, that it shall be one with the Divine Itself...
For Jehovah was above the Heavens, but that which passed through the Heavens from Him was the Divine Human then; for, through the influx of Jehovah into Heaven a man was reproduced...
That Jehovah was (at the burning bush) in the Divine Human...
In these passages the Divine Itself, which is called Jehovah, is distinguished from the Divine Human...
But that it is Jehovah Himself in the Divine Human. Illustrated.
From these passages it is evident that by Jehovah in the Word no other is meant than the Lord. References. AC 7091:4.
Jehovah -the Lord. References. AC 6839.
For He was conceived from Jehovah; hence the inmost of His life was Jehovah Himself.
After He was fully glorified, He made His Human to be the Divine good, thus one with Jehovah. AC 6753:end.
This transflux was the Divine Human before the Lord's Advent, and was Jehovah Himself in the Heavens, or the Lord.
The Hebrew Church... also acknowledged Jehovah.
In (the Ancient Church) no other (than the Lord) was meant by Jehovah.
In proportion as He was in the Human made Divine... He was God and Jehovah.
The Divine was indeed in Him, because He was conceived from Jehovah...
Then He was one with Jehovah.
It was sufficient for that people to worship Jehovah merely as to the name...
When the Lord became the Divine Esse or Jehovah as to the Human also...
Jehovah God = the Divine of the Lord.
Jehovah God = the Lord; Jehovah, His Divine Esse; and God, the derivative Divine Existere.
Jehovah seen () = the appearing of the Divine of the Lord in His Human; (for) Jehovah = the Lord as to the Divine Itself and as to the Divine Human. References. AC 6956.
The Divine is signified by Jehovah. Hence it is evident that by Moses said to Jehovah () is signified that the Lord had perception in the Human from His Divine.
The Divine Itself which is called the Father is meant by Jehovah.
By Jehovah is meant the Lord as to the Divine good.
That Jehovah had visited the sons of Israel () = that those of the Spiritual Church were delivered and saved by the Advent of the Lord... Jehovah in the Word = the Lord. References.
Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel () = (exhortation) from the Divine Human of the Lord. By Jehovah the God of Israel is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human. Explained, Illustrated.
Jehovah = the Lord. AC 7097.
I know not Jehovah () = that they do not care for the Lord... As to Pharaoh saying that he did not know Jehovah, the case is this. From ancient time the Egyptians knew Jehovah...

But when Divine worship was thus perverted in Egypt, they were no longer allowed to worship Jehovah, and at last not even to know that Jehovah was the God of the Ancient Church... lest they should profane the name of Jehovah. That the name of Jehovah had been known at that time... is evident from the fact that Balaam, who was from Syria, not only knew Jehovah, but also adored Him, and sacrificed to Him.
I am Jehovah () = confirmation by the Divine, which is irrevocable. Illustrated. AC 7213. AC 7242.
And in the Prophets, Saith Jehovah, by which in like manner is meant confirmation by the Divine. Illustrated.

In My name Jehovah I was not known to them () = that those who are of the Spiritual Church in a state of temptations did not think about the Divine things which are of the Church. The name of Jehovah = everything in one complex by which God is worshipped; thus everything Divine in the Church. By the name of Jehovah is properly meant the Lord's Divine Human...

But from the historical sense of these words it may be evident that Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob did not worship Jehovah, but God Shaddai... But the reason why Jehovah is mentioned in the historicals concerning Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, is that that Word was written by Moses, to whom the name of Jehovah had been made known; and in those historicals Jehovah is mentioned for the sake of the internal sense; for everywhere in the Word Jehovah is mentioned when it treats of the good which is of love...
Ye shall Know that I am Jehovah your God () = apperception then that the Lord is the only God. AC 7636.
Jehovah the God of the Hebrews () = the Divine of the Church... Jehovah God = the Lord; Jehovah, as to the Divine good; and God as to Divine truth. AC 7499. AC 7539.
There is none like unto Jehovah our God () = that there is one God, and none besides Him. Explained.
That thou mayest know that I Jehovah am in the midst of the land () = the apperception that the Lord is the only God of the Church... By I Jehovah is signified that I alone am. AC 7598.
The Lord (then) made the Human also Divine good; that is, Jehovah...
The hand of Jehovah = omnipotence.
Jehovah is just... () = that the Divine good could not endure it... By Jehovah is meant the Divine Esse, which is the Divine good...
Jehovah God = the Lord. AC 7727.
The face of Jehovah = mercy.
To serve Jehovah = to worship the Lord. AC 7722. AC 7730. AC 7958.
lam Jehovah = that the Lord is the only God. AC 8139. AC 8189.
Jehovah will pass through () = the presence of the Divine.
The sacrifice of the passover to Jehovah () = the worship of the Lord on account of deliverance.
Jehovah, in the Word, = the Lord as to Divine good.

Who is as Thou in the gods, Jehovah? () = that all the truth of good proceeds from the Divine Human of the Lord... The reason the Divine Human is here meant by Jehovah, is that in this song it treats of the salvation of those who are of the Spiritual Church by the Advent of the Lord...
Jehovah shall reign for ever and to eternity () = that the Lord alone is the Lord of Heaven and earth.
Jehovah = the Divine; here, the Divine truth.
At heart they did not acknowledge Jehovah...
The war of Jehovah () = casting into Hell. Explained.
Jehovah is said where good is treated of. References. AC 8988:3. AC 9160:2.
Jehovah = the Lord's Divine Human.
Jehovah = the Divine good of the Divine love. References.
I am Jehovah thy God () = the Lord as to the Divine Human reigning universally in each and all things of good and truth. AC 8874.
The Lord is called Jehovah from the Divine good, which is the Divine Esse; and God from the Divine truth, which is the Divine Existere. References.
The reason it is the Divine Human which is here meant by Jehovah God. Explained.
Jehovah God = the Divine there.
Therefore... His Divine good from which Divine truth proceeds, is Jehovah. Explained.
Jehovah = the Divine Esse; and Lord, the Divine Existere from Esse.
Jehovah as the Father = the Divine good of the Divine love, which is Esse itself.
Therefore the Lord as to the Divine Human is called the name of Jehovah.
For the Lord as to the Divine Human is Jehovah or the Father in a visible form.

For, many Angels who appeared before the Lord's Advent into the world were Jehovah Himself in a human form, or in the form of an Angel, as is manifestly evident from the fact that they called the Angels who appeared, Jehovah. Illustrated.
Jehovah Himself in a human form, or, what is the same, in the form of an Angel, was the Lord... Illustrated.
That Jehovah could not appear in any other way. Illustrated.
Know, therefore, that the Lord is Jehovah Himself, or the Father, in a human form. Illustrated.
That the Divine truth could not be revealed to men, except by Jehovah in a human form. Illustrated.

(Thus) the Lord from eternity was Jehovah or the Father in a human form, but not yet in the flesh; for an Angel has no flesh: and as Jehovah or the Father willed to put on all the Human, for the sake of the salvation of the human race, He therefore assumed the flesh also.
